# A-3 · Control Assessments

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | A Assess (system level) |
| Phases | PH-EMD (primary) |
| Depends on | A-2 |
| Inputs | ART-SAP, ART-SSP, ART-STIG, EXT-TEST-RESULTS, EXT-ASSESSMENT-PROCEDURES, EXT-SOFTWARE-EVIDENCE |
| Outputs | ART-SAR (produces), ART-STIG (updates) |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PER-SCA · A: PER-SCA · C: PER-AODR, PER-PM, PER-CCP, PER-IO, PER-ISSM, PER-ISSO, PER-PRIV, PER-CDT, PER-OTA, PER-DEV · I: PER-AO, PER-CISO · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [PER-SCA](../../personas/PER-SCA.md), [PER-AODR](../../personas/PER-AODR.md), [PER-PM](../../personas/PER-PM.md), [PER-CCP](../../personas/PER-CCP.md), [PER-IO](../../personas/PER-IO.md), [PER-ISSM](../../personas/PER-ISSM.md), [PER-ISSO](../../personas/PER-ISSO.md), [PER-PRIV](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [PER-CDT](../../personas/PER-CDT.md), [PER-OTA](../../personas/PER-OTA.md), [PER-DEV](../../personas/PER-DEV.md) |

Purpose: Assess the controls per the approved plan, reusing developer, developmental and operational test results and prior assessments, and automating where possible.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** A-2 is done (`sap.yaml` approved). Why: the assessment follows the
   approved plan; anything outside it needs the AODR's agreement first.
2. **Adopt the assessor's stance.** For this task you act as PER-SCA: independent of the
   program, evidence-first. Read `personas/PER-SCA.md` `## Role-play guidance` before
   starting. A control is `satisfied` only when evidence shows it is implemented as the SSP
   states **and** meets the control's intent; the SSP's own claim is not evidence. Why: the
   AO relies on the SAR to know the real risk (SP 800-53Ar5 §3.3).
3. **Read the inputs** in `## Inputs`: the plan, the STIG results and the test results first,
   then the SSP family by family.
4. **Work family by family** with `_shared/ssp-batching.md` (A-3 variant), at most 3
   families per session. For each family:
   1. Interview the people who run the controls (assessment interviews are the
      `interview` method): PER-ISSO for operations, PER-DEV for built-in mechanisms,
      PER-CCP for inherited parts. Ask for evidence, not descriptions: records, settings,
      results, dates.
   2. Write `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml` whole from `templates/data/sar-results.yaml`:
      - one `determinations` record per scoped control: `result` (`satisfied`,
        `other-than-satisfied`, `not-evaluated`, `not-applicable`), `methods` actually used
        (those the plan selected), the `depth` and `coverage` the assessors applied, not
        below the plan's procedure values (RIGR-002), a `summary` naming the evidence, `finding_refs` for an
        other-than-satisfied result, `statements` with a `result` for every determination
        statement of the control (`rmf catalog show --fields objectives`; a `not-applicable`
        statement takes a `reason`, and the control can still be satisfied), `reused` naming
        any `RR-###` it rests on, `sources`. `not-applicable` is this tool's term and maps to
        CNSSI 1254 "not evaluated";
      - one `findings` record per weakness: `id` (`FND-###`, numbered across the whole run,
        continuing from the highest on disk), `control_id`, `title`, `description` (what the
        control requires, what was observed, the evidence), `status: open` (or `closed` if
        fixed and re-tested during the assessment), `severity` on the SP 800-30 scale
        (`very-low` to `very-high`), `recommendation`, `affected_statements` (the
        other-than-satisfied statements it covers), `state_difference` (how the actual state
        differs from the expected state), `potential_compromise`, `sources`.
      - An SSP status of `partial` or `planned`, an open STIG finding mapped to the
        control, or a test failure means the control is `other-than-satisfied`, unless the
        evidence shows the gap is closed. Why: these are the weaknesses the POA&M (A-6) and
        the risk analysis (R-2) depend on; hiding them makes the package vacuous.
   3. `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --family <fam>`.
   4. CHECKPOINT for the family.
   Reuse a test event's results as assessment evidence only when `test-strategy.yaml` marks it
   `results_reused: true` on a production-representative system in an operationally
   representative environment, with its configuration and conditions recorded (TSTRAT-003).
   Why: results from a prototype or a laboratory say nothing about the system the AO
   authorizes.
5. **Update the STIG summary.** A-3 updates ART-STIG with the assessor's verification:
   - Rewrite `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml` whole if the assessment changed a finding's
     status (for example a fix verified on all units); otherwise leave its content as is.
   - In `artifacts/ART-STIG.md`, append `A-3` to `touched_by` and add a
     `## Assessor verification (A-3)` section: which results were witnessed or re-run, which
     open findings were confirmed, traced. Why: A-3 lists ART-STIG as an output; it is not
     done until ART-STIG's `touched_by` includes A-3.
6. **Write `artifacts/data/sar-summary.yaml`** from `templates/data/sar-summary.yaml`: the
   `assessment_type`, the assessment `environment` (site, security, supporting equipment,
   external interfaces active, and every person present with organization and role), the
   `assumptions`, `limitations` and `issues`, the `sca` and contact, and each `site` with its
   assessment dates (CNSSI 1254 Annex C). When the plan scheduled a penetration test, record
   its results: the log of all activities, the exploited vulnerabilities and how they were
   combined into attacks, the likelihood from the effort expended, the controls it
   validated, remediation for each successful attack and the SAR findings it produced; on a
   cATO path also the date the AO was given them and the lessons learned (PENT-002).
7. **Write `artifacts/data/sar-report.yaml`** from `templates/data/sar-report.yaml`
   (`methodology`, with `deviation_rationale` when it is not SP 800-53A), and
   **`artifacts/ART-SAR.md`** from `templates/artifacts/ART-SAR.md` after the last
   family: assessment summary, test results reused, naming every `RR-###` and `EXT-###` of the
   plan with its date and type, findings overview with the most significant weaknesses, and
   recommendations, each traced. Name findings by ID
   (`FND-###`); do not copy every determination into the Markdown, because the family
   files are the one home of the results.
8. **Build and check the task.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then
   `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-3`, until 0 errors.
9. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT for the task.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-ISSO | consulted (C); operates the controls | records of account reviews, log review evidence, patch status per unit, configuration scan results |
| PER-DEV | consulted (C); built-in mechanisms and test results | how lockout, session lock and firewall rules are enforced; DT results; update bundle contents |
| PER-CCP | consulted (C); inherited parts | evidence the provider's part is in place for this system |
| PER-PM (optional) | consulted (C) | program response to weaknesses found, planned fixes |

At least 1 interview with `task: A-3`. The agent acts as PER-SCA (accountable and
responsible); the SCA is the interviewer, not a respondent.

## Inputs

- `artifacts/ART-SAP.md`, `artifacts/data/sap.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-STIG.md`, `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml`
- Assessment objectives: `uv run rmf catalog show --family <fam> --run <run> --fields title,objectives`
- `product/test-results.md` (developer and developmental test results, EXT-TEST-RESULTS)

## Outputs

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml` | — | one per family, schema `sar-results`, written whole |
| `artifacts/data/sar-report.yaml` | — | schema `sar-report`, methodology; A-4 adds to it |
| `artifacts/ART-SAR.md` | `artifact_id: ART-SAR`, `produced_by_task: A-3`, `touched_by: [A-3]` | |
| `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml` | — | rewritten only if a status changed |
| `artifacts/ART-STIG.md` | `touched_by: [I-1, A-3]` | updated (updater) |

## Facts

A-3 writes no facts.

## Done when

- Every scoped control has a determination (SAR-COV-001), every other-than-satisfied
  determination names its findings, and every finding has a severity and recommendation.
- ART-STIG lists A-3 in `touched_by`.
- A system that accepts remote access from non-government equipment has `telework` in
  `artifacts/data/ssp-records.yaml` consistent with what the assessment saw (TELE-001).
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-3` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- One CHECKPOINT per family: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task A-3 · family: <fam>`.
- A final CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task A-3`, with the result mix and the
  number of open findings.
- If you changed an SSP statement because the assessment proved it wrong, that is a
  CORRECTION to ART-SSP outside A-3's outputs: do not make it; record a NOTE instead (S-4's
  updaters I-2 and A-5 own that change).
